measure.description: Optional (C-33) for performance ACs: Judge PASS needs `measurement record` with at least 3 runs, a limiter, and spread smaller than the effect.

rubric.description: Optional (C-09) for subjective ACs: criteria the Devil's Advocate scores with evidence in ledger.rubricScores. Judge PASS needs every criterion scored pass:true.

pass.description: What counts as passing, e.g. 'contrast >= 4.5:1 (WCAG AA)'

verify.description: Optional (C-07, C-23). What proves this AC: an exact `command`, a verification catalog `key` (e.g. pentest, property, formal; default verify runs it when configured), or a `layer` (any passing command of that layer). Gate judge refuses PASS until it passed on the gated diff.

crossComponent.description: Optional (#110). true when the AC crosses a component boundary; claimed-vs-reality then needs L3 (end-to-end) evidence or an 'L3 waived: <reason>' Layer cell before gate review.

scope.description: Optional file scope frozen with the Goal (#59). Absent = no path enforcement. Globs: ** crosses directories, * stays in one segment, a trailing / is a directory prefix.

designRef.description: Optional design document this Goal implements (#97): written by `goal draft --from-design`. targetFiles feed the design drift check.

flow.description: Optional (C-21, C-27): the intended flow as transitions. goal draft renders it as a From | Event | To table; goal diagram renders it as a state machine, storyboard or actor lanes before freeze; the receipt shows it next to the verification artifacts.

actor.description: Who performs the step (user, app, service, db, cron). Missing means user.

ac.description: Acceptance criterion that covers this effect. Missing means a side effect no AC covers.

hotspot.description: An open question about this transition, or true.

flowSubject.description: Optional (C-27): the entity whose status the flow describes; makes the state view the recommended one.

forbiddenTransitions.description: Optional (C-27): state/event pairs the human decided are invalid; the transition table shows them as invalid instead of undecided.

plainSummary.description: Optional (C-28): one sentence for non-technical readers, used by `recap --for client`.

featureId.description: Optional (C-15): id of the feature in .ai-engineering-loop/features.json this Goal delivers. Goal freeze marks it active; delivery marks it passing with this Run as evidence.

outOfScope.description: Optional list of things this Goal must not change.
